\section{\texttt{QdrantAgentSnapshots}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.qdrant_ingestion.QdrantAgentSnapshots}\index{Classes!QdrantAgentSnapshots}

Serve Qdrant through snapshots coordinated by one shared local lock path.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
QdrantAgentSnapshots(self, settings: Settings) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{settings}] \texttt{Settings}, required.
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Raises}\texttt{ValueError}
\apifield{Details}All workers and external writers must cooperate on that path. Every request downloads the collection's chunks and vectors under the lock, then releases it before answering. Retrieval and dataset tools share that snapshot, while other workers can ingest and in-flight answers retain their selected data. This mode trades remote search scalability for consistent local snapshots.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}qdrant\_\allowbreak{}ingestion.\allowbreak{}py:21}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/8b368cc9cacfeeb963e13557b856067186e3b59f/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/qdrant_ingestion.py#L21}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.qdrant_ingestion}
